## Technical comparison

| Component | Semantics | Keyboard support | Publishing compatibility | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Table | Native table with headers | Focusable horizontal scroll | Markdown and Notion | `extraordinarily_long_configuration_identifier` |
| Disclosure | Native details and summary | Enter and Space | Markdown and Notion | No JavaScript required |

```typescript
}
console.log(configuration)
```
